Do I need to give you my Google password?
No. We use Google OAuth. You authorize our access with one click, using Google's own secure system. We never see or store your Google password. Alternatively, you can add
as a Manager to your GBP manually from your GBP settings.
What if I want to approve posts before they go live?

Currently, posts are published automatically on schedule. If you'd like to review content before publishing, you can email us at any time and we'll set you up on a preview workflow (available on Authority plan).
Can I request custom posts for promotions or events?
Absolutely. Email us at grow@localboostlab.com with the details and we'll create and schedule a custom post. On the Authority plan, urgent custom posts are handled within 4 hours.
What happens if my profile gets flagged by Google?

We follow Google's GBP content policies strictly. All content is reviewed against current guidelines before publishing. On the Authority plan, you also get monthly health audits and suspension risk alerts. In the unlikely event of a flag, we immediately pause posting and help you respond to Google's process. We never modify your Google Business Profile settings, verification status, or account configuration. Our agents operate only on content and review responses.
What if I don't have any photos to upload?

No problem. We use AI-generated images that are appropriate for your industry and services. We'll always use your real photos when you have them, they perform better, but we can keep your profile active with generated imagery in the meantime.
